atoms.name: Framing and bit stuffing
atoms.one_line: Flag 01111110 marks frame edges; the sender inserts a 0 after every five 1s in the data, the receiver removes it.

atoms.name: Parity and Hamming distance
atoms.one_line: One parity bit catches any odd number of flips. Minimum distance d detects d-1 errors and corrects floor((d-1)/2).

atoms.name: CRC
atoms.one_line: Generator of degree r gives r check bits: append r zeros, divide by XOR, append the remainder. Receiver remainder 0 means accepted.

atoms.name: Hamming single-error-correcting code
atoms.one_line: Check bits at positions 1,2,4,8; need 2^r >= m+r+1. The syndrome is the position of the flipped bit.

atoms.name: Stop-and-wait
atoms.one_line: Window of one frame. U = Tt/(Tt+2Tp) with negligible ack; add ack time and overhead when given.

atoms.name: Sliding window efficiency
atoms.one_line: U = min(1, W Tt/(Tt+2Tp)). Full utilisation needs W = 1 + 2Tp/Tt.

atoms.name: Sequence number bits
atoms.one_line: Go-Back-N needs W+1 numbers (W <= 2^n - 1). Selective repeat needs 2W numbers (W <= 2^(n-1)). Byte numbering also needs no wrap in the lifetime.

atoms.name: Go-Back-N versus selective repeat behaviour
atoms.one_line: GBN resends everything from the lost frame after a timeout; SR resends only the lost frame.

atoms.name: CSMA/CD and minimum frame size
atoms.one_line: Frame must last a round trip: L >= 2 Tp R. Binary exponential backoff picks from 0..2^n - 1 after n collisions.

atoms.name: ALOHA and slotted contention
atoms.one_line: Pure S = G e^(-2G), max 0.184. Slotted S = G e^(-G), max 0.368. Exactly one of n senders: n p (1-p)^(n-1).

atoms.name: MAC addresses, switches and frame addressing
atoms.one_line: MAC is 48 bits and only valid on one link. Switches learn from source MAC; routers rewrite MAC at each hop while IP stays.
